title: Senate to conduct inquiry on P700-M rice smuggling attempt from Vietnam

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Committee on Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform will soon conduct a hearing into the attempted smuggling of around P700 million worth of rice from Vietnam, according to Sen. Francis Pangilinan. He said the incident raises serious concerns over the continued lack of convictions of big-time smugglers and how this apparent impunity allows large-scale smuggling operations to persist. Pangilinan, the chair of the committee, said he is eyeing to conduct the hearing before the end of the month or possibly at the same time with the budget hearing the Department of Agriculture. “Before the end of the […]...
